```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Unique and Permanent Identifiers and Support for Formatting

  Doorstop shall provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text.
  Doorstop shall support formatting within linkable text.
  Doorstop shall support the storage of external requirements assets.
  Doorstop shall be able to import content from other requirements management tools.
  Doorstop shall be able to export content to interact with common text/document tools.
  Doorstop shall provide a way to view requirements as a document.
  Doorstop shall provide a way to view document items interactively.
  Doorstop shall provide the capability to baseline versions of requirements.

  Scenario: Doorstop provides unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    Given a new document is created
    When a linkable section of text is added
    Then a unique and permanent identifier is assigned to the section

  Scenario: Doorstop supports formatting within linkable text
    Given a new document is created
    And a linkable section of text is added
    When formatting options are applied to the text
    Then the formatting is supported within the linkable text

  Scenario: Doorstop supports the storage of external requirements assets
    Given a new document is created
    And external requirements assets are imported
    Then the assets are stored and can be accessed later

  Scenario: Doorstop can import content from other requirements management tools
    Given a new document is created
    When content is imported from another requirements management tool
    Then the content is imported and integrated into the Doorstop system

  Scenario: Doorstop can export content to interact with common text/document tools
    Given a document is created in Doorstop
    When the document is exported to a common text/document format
    Then the exported content can be opened and edited in standard tools

  Scenario: Doorstop provides a way to view requirements as a document
    Given a document contains requirements
    When the document is viewed as a whole
    Then the requirements are presented in a structured format

  Scenario: Doorstop provides a way to view document items interactively
    Given a document contains multiple items
    When the items are viewed interactively
    Then the items can be navigated and details accessed

  Scenario: Doorstop provides the capability to baseline versions of requirements
    Given a requirement document exists
    When a baseline version is created
    Then the baseline version is saved and can be compared to later versions
```
